# Rows db.x1bp.* (line RG, X1b-p, 2026-11-18; -db class N lifted in X1b-q, 2026-11-25): the HSPs of db.x1bo.* in more reports. .d3m (x1bp_d3m_s.fna, the minus-strand subject of x1bo_d3_s.fna) and .rs (x1bo_R_short_s.fna) keep an HSP whose Seq-align query start lies past the query's end, which NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 shows in every report (its query letters past the end as the gap character); .db rows search tests/db_search/x1bp/{d3m,rs,d3} (makeblastdb of the subject files). The .rej rows keep one with a start below 0 with -subject, where NCBI stops with CAnnotMapperException in the batch's search after the prologs and the reports of the batches before, which LOSAT writes before its refusal (x1bp_d2b_q.fna: a random q0 of 1300 letters before x1bo_q.fna's qA and qB); from a database, db.x1bp.d3.db.6 and db.x1bp.d3t.db.6 (plus blastn.x1bq.tsv) match NCBI BLAST+ 2.17.0 per report. Fix 2 (2026-11-18, review 1 M1 and S1): -query_loc, whose interval NCBI cuts from the record, while its reports read the record's letters outside it (alnvec.cpp:108-124) and move an ungapped HSP's query row by the interval's start (Dense-diag OffsetRow): .ql, .qpa (x1bp_qloc_q.fna, x1bp_qpA_*.fna, written by remaining-gaps X/x1bp/fix2/scripts/gen_f2.py), .d3pk, .r3k, .rsp (the x1bp_pre

_*.fna queries: P random letters before each record of x1bo_q.fna, x1bo_rv_q.fna and x1bo_R_q.fna, and -query_loc (P+1)-1000000, the original search); .d3t is a database with taxid 9606.
